title: Formalize dimensional visual registers and perceptual state space

reason.summary: Treat OHF families/subdimensions as observable visual variables and define capacity from their combinations without confusing nominal mathematical capacity with perceptually safe capacity.

before.dimension_model: families described conceptually; no executable hierarchical register/capacity model

after.dimension_model: hierarchical MICRO/MESO/MACRO registry with leaf observable variables
after.capacity_model: scope-aware nominal capacity plus separate SAFE_PSS capacity
after.orthogonality: explicit PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN pair evidence and candidate compatibility search
after.machine_model: finite multidimensional visual tape/registers + attention head + bounded SAFE_MICRO_ISA/Glyph Calculus transitions in Go
